sourceProvenance: Implementation content identities captured before commit/publication; the coordinating PR ledger records the publication commit.

localAuthority.scope: Actual neutral bindings, typed registry, independent V8 public replay and 11-client legacy absence; no ML runtime or source admission

sharedModel.scope: Actual shared recurrent runtime, explicit controlled lifecycle/lexical decisions, reserved/waiting/terminal and two-session reconstruction; separate unchanged actual decoder failure control

review.finding: Exact delivered child receipt retries were incorrectly blocked by later public/pending/terminal state. Historical reads now bind the original public+contexts+result and create no new authority.
review.closedControl: Exact saved receipt returned with sessionRetained false, no reopened session or mutation
review.probeScope: Actual completion API + V8 replay + typed registry over an explicitly assembled already-delivered state; no model generation/dispatch claim
review.probeRelocation: Retained scripts only replace their scratch-relative root with repository-relative paths; rerun JSON is byte-data equivalent to independent retained results.

limits: Dynamic callbacks/descendants/module initialization outside this bounded coordinator profile
Remote effect rollback and resource restoration remain separate
Ordinary guest semantic commit retains its existing fail-closed acknowledgement-loss behavior
Producer orchestration bridge/collector and default routing remain separate work
